Chandra Pratap Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And
Another on 22 May, 2023

Author: Rajiv Gupta
Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Court No. - 65

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satyendra Narain Singh In Person Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court, is taken on record.

2.Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State, Shri Satyendra Narain Singh,
In person, counsel for the opposite party No. 2, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and perused the record.
3.This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the Charge Sheet No. 116 of 2013 dated 16.8.2013 and summoning order dated 22.3.2022 as well as further proceeding of Criminal Case No. 40697 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No. 367 of 2011, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 380, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Gola, District- Gorakhpur, pending Chandra Pratap Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64789293/
1 in the court of Judicial Magistrate-2nd, Gorakhpur.

entities.text: Chandra Pratap Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4.Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that opposite party No. 2 is the nephew of applicant No. 1 and cousin of applicant No. 2 and on account of family dispute, the present criminal case has been instituted against the applicants, however with the intervention of respected members of both the family and society, parties have amicably settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against each other.
A settlement-agreement dated 3.5.2023 has also been drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure No. SA.-1 to the supplementary affidavit.

5. This court vide order dated 6.4.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the court below and to file the compromise, which shall be verified in the presence of the parties and after verification, a report shall be submitted by the trial court.

6.Pursuant to the said order, both the parties appeared before the trial court on 3.5.2023 and filed the compromise made between the parties and in their presence, the said compromise has been verified and a report dated 3.5.2023 has been forwarded to this Court, a copy of which has been filed as Annexure- SA-1 to the supplementary affidavit.
7.Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the compromise made between the parties, entire proceedings be quashed against the applicants.

8.Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2- Shir Satyendra Narain Singh has appeared In Person and has acknowledged the said compromise and has further stated that he has no objection if the entire proceedings are quashed.

9.This Court is not unmindful of the judgement of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab, (2014) 6 SCC 466, Parbatbhai Aahir @ Parbatbhai Vs. State of Gujarat (2017) 9 SCC, 641, Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303 and State of M.P. Vs.
Laxmi Narayanan (2019) 5 SCC 688, wherein Hon'ble Apex Court has categorically held that compromise can be made between the parties even in respect of certain cognizable and non compoundable offences.

sentences.text: Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another [2013 (83) ACC 278], in which the law expounded by the Apex court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10.Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, the court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose shall be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned case.

11.Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 40697 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No. 367 of 2011, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 380, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Gola,
District- Gorakhpur, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate-2nd, Gorakhpur, are hereby quashed.
